description: This file contains utility functions for generating and deleting QR codes for invoices in Saudi Arabia, including creating custom fields, encoding invoice data into TLV format, and managing related files.

methods.name: create_qr_code
methods.description: Generates a QR code for an invoice document if in Saudi Arabia, encoding seller info, VAT, timestamp, and totals into TLV format, and attaches the QR code image as a file.

methods.name: delete_qr_code_file
methods.description: Deletes the QR code file associated with an invoice document in Saudi Arabia.

methods.name: delete_vat_settings_for_company
methods.description: Deletes the VAT settings for a company if the country is Saudi Arabia.
